name: Compound V3 (Comet, USDC market)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths not all checked

narrative.summary: A fully closed chain: Comet.governor() is a LocalTimelock that also controls upgrades (confirmed via the EIP-1967 admin slot), answering to Compound’s real Ethereum-mainnet Governance Timelock via a bridge receiver.
narrative.detail: LocalTimelock’s own delay() is re-confirmed live at a real 86,400s (1 day) - the actually-enforced LOCAL delay on Base. The L1 Compound Timelock’s own separate delay is out of scope for this Base-RPC-only scorer.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://mainnet.base.org -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xb125e6687d4313864e53df431d5425969c15eb2f","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","0x3226612"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://mainnet.base.org -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x3226612"]}'
# delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
curl -s -X POST https://mainnet.base.org -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0xcc3e7c85bb0ee4f09380e041fee95a0caedd4a02","data":"0x6a42b8f8"},"latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://mainnet.base.org -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xb125e6687d4313864e53df431d5425969c15eb2f","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 52585995 and 52586002 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
main_gap.reason: The waiting time may be skipped
